picks.name: Sulfate-Free Moisture Shampoo
picks.why: Cleanses without stripping the natural oils that 3B–4C coils depend on to stay hydrated.

picks.name: Co-Wash Cleansing Conditioner
picks.why: A gentler wash-day option for tightly coiled hair that dries out easily between washes.

picks.name: Scalp Clarifying Rinse
picks.why: Clears product buildup at the root without disturbing curl clumping further down the shaft.

picks.name: Curl Defining Cream
picks.why: Locks in moisture and encourages coil clumping for more consistent definition.

picks.name: Edge Control Gel
picks.why: Lightweight hold for laying edges without flaking on coily textures.

picks.name: Twist-Out Butter
picks.why: Rich enough to hold a twist-out's shape through 4A–4C shrinkage.

picks.name: Leave-In Detangler Spray
picks.why: Softens strands enough to detangle 3C–4C coils without breakage.

picks.name: Weekly Deep Conditioning Mask
picks.why: Restores elasticity that's especially important for high-porosity, tightly coiled hair.

picks.name: Protein-Strengthening Treatment
picks.why: Reinforces strand strength for coily hair prone to breakage at the curl bends.

picks.name: Hot Oil Scalp Treatment
picks.why: Soothes a dry or sensitive scalp while sealing moisture into the lengths.
